content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment refers to a streamlined process where digital products are delivered instantly upon confirmation of payment in cryptocurrency. This model eliminates the reliance on traditional payment processors, which often charge high transaction fees and impose geographical restrictions. For instance, while Gumroad charges a hefty 10% on each sale, using NOWPayments incurs only a 0.5% fee. This significant difference means that for every 100 sales at $97, creators can retain an extra $921 — money that can be reinvested into their projects or marketing efforts.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure behind automated ebook delivery consists of various components working in sync. First, hosting is provided by platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring that your content is accessible globally. Backend logic can be managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automating the delivery process. When a payment is made via NOWPayments, an automatic webhook triggers the delivery of the ebook. This architecture not only enhances reliability but also ensures cost-effectiveness, as these services are often free or low-cost, allowing creators to focus on their content without worrying about hidden fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is specifically designed for digital creators in regions with limited access to conventional payment platforms. Whether you sell ebooks, courses, or digital templates, the architecture provides a sovereign way to accept payments and deliver products without incurring high fees or losing control. By adopting this infrastructure, creators can establish a scalable online store that aligns with their needs and audience, allowing them to thrive in an otherwise restrictive environment.
Automated delivery means no waiting for your customers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this automated delivery system include hosting (GitHub or Cloudflare), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script), order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), and file delivery (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). Integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions completes the stack. Each of these elements plays a vital role in ensuring a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer, facilitating immediate product access after payment is confirmed. This comprehensive approach guarantees that creators maintain ownership and have a reliable infrastructure for their digital sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your automated ebook delivery system, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages and set up your store. Next, configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment options, ensuring you choose the right blockchain for low transaction fees. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets for easy access, and set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant file delivery. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline this process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing automated delivery systems that leverage cryptocurrency payments. By employing a stack that includes NOWPayments for payment processing and a combination of free tools for hosting and delivery, you can efficiently sell your digital products and retain more of your profits.
Lower fees with NOWPayments translate to higher profit margins.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Select a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your digital store. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate payment processing. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing to reduce fees. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for storing order data securely. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for on-demand file delivery.
